About
About
Sonel S.A. is a leader in the production of measuring instruments and accessories for the power industry, electrical engineering, industry, and telecommunications. The company offers a wide range of products, including meters, analyzers, and thermal imaging cameras. Thanks to innovative technological solutions, Sonel ensures the highest quality and precision of its devices. The company also has its own research and calibration laboratory, which provides calibration services.
